title: CmdPal: Prevent failing event handlers from blocking updates

proposed_comments.title: Remove disconnected lifecycle subscribers
proposed_comments.body: When a subscriber throws RPC_E_DISCONNECTED or RPC_S_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE, this call does not provide an unsubscribe callback, so the dead handler remains in InternalItemsChanged and is retried on every update. Please pass a lifecycle-aware callback such as `handler => ItemsChanged -= handler` so the page can transition to the correct unloaded state when its last live subscriber disappears.

proposed_comments.title: Remove disconnected lifecycle subscribers
proposed_comments.body: This lifecycle-aware page also omits the unsubscribe callback, so disconnected RPC handlers remain in InternalItemsChanged and are retried on every notification. Please pass `handler => ItemsChanged -= handler` to remove the dead subscriber through the event accessor and keep the load count and Loaded/Unloaded transitions accurate.
